title: Rehello
summary: Made for introverts to remember people & reconnect naturally
content: Rehello: Made for introverts to remember people & reconnect naturally | Product Hunt Launching today Rehello Launching today Made for introverts to remember people & reconnect naturally 37 followers Made for introverts to remember people & reconnect naturally 37 followers Visit website Note and writing apps Rehello is a people-memory companion designed for introverts. After meeting someone, jot down a messy memory in your own words. GPT-5.6 turns it into a structured recall card—who they are, where you met, what matters to them, and an easy conversation opener for next time. Unlike a CRM, Rehello isn’t about networking or managing leads. It reduces the mental load of remembering people, so reconnecting feels natural, thoughtful, and less awkward. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team More Free Launch tags: Productivity • Artificial Intelligence • GitHub Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 45 Day Rank Upvote • 67 points Follow Rehello Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info re-hello.vercel.app GitHub Rehello Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/rehello Similar Products Granola The AI notepad for people in back-to-back meetings 4.8 ( 51 reviews ) Meeting software AI notetakers Limitless Preserve conversations and ask your personalized AI anything 4.7 ( 76 reviews ) Search Meeting software Reflect Fast networked note-taking 4.8 ( 45 reviews ) Productivity Note and writing apps Me.bot Your second brain that enhances your memory & creativity 4.6 ( 37 reviews ) AI Chatbots HyNote AI Full Stack AI Note Taker For Professionals 4.8 ( 38 reviews ) Note and writing apps AI notetakers View more Subscribe Sign in Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment HuiYing Chung Rehello Maker 📌 I built Rehello for introverts who care about people but find it difficult to remember every detail and restart conversations naturally. The problem isn’t a lack of interest. After meeting someone, names, context, interests, and small personal details can quickly become a blur. By the next conversation, even sending a simple message can feel awkward. Most relationship tools feel like CRMs—built around pipelines, follow-ups, and networking. Rehello takes a gentler approach. Simply write down a messy memory in your own words, and GPT-5.6 turns it into a structured recall card. Before meeting again, you can quickly remember who the person is, what mattered in your last conversation, and a natural place to pick things back up. The guiding idea behind Rehello is simple: you shouldn’t have to organize the memory—the product should. It isn’t about collecting contacts or optimizing relationships. It’s about reducing the mental load of caring for people. I’d love to hear: Does Rehello feel helpful rather than transactional? What would make reconnecting easier for you? What part of remembering people is hardest? Thanks for checking out Rehello Upvote (2) Report Share

summary: Starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle
content: AgentLoop: Starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle | Product Hunt Launching today AgentLoop Launching today Starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle 72 followers Starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle 72 followers Visit website AI Coding Agents Unlike long-running agent chats, AgentLoop starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle. Set the goal and GUIDELINES.md rubric once; workers build, critics test, and failures become concrete fix notes for the next clean context. Project files carry the memory. title: Megaphone
summary: Open-source Mac dictation App that's 100% on-device
content: Megaphone: Open-source Mac dictation App that's 100% on-device | Product Hunt Launching today Megaphone Launching today Open-source Mac dictation App that's 100% on-device 85 followers Open-source Mac dictation App that's 100% on-device 85 followers Visit website AI Dictation Apps Hold Fn, speak, and Megaphone types clean text into any Mac app. Apple’s SpeechAnalyzer transcribes as you talk, while on-device Foundation Models remove fillers, fix self-corrections, adapt to app context, and power inline voice commands. No account, API key, subscription, or server. Free, MIT-licensed, and native to Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team More Free Launch tags: Productivity • Artificial Intelligence • GitHub Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 17 Day Rank Upvote • 101 points Follow Megaphone Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info megaphone.kuber.studio GitHub Megaphone Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/megaphone-3 Similar Products Wispr Flow Speak naturally, write perfectly & 4x faster in every app 4.7 ( 73 reviews ) AI Dictation Apps TalkTastic Voice Keyboard that Understands Your Personal Context 4.9 ( 26 reviews ) Text-to-Speech Software AI Dictation Apps superwhisper Extremely accurate, voice to text for Mac & iPhone 4.9 ( 21 reviews ) AI Dictation Apps Typeless AI voice dictation that's actually intelligent 5.0 ( 10 reviews ) Writing assistants AI Dictation Apps Snaply Free & private AI, designed for you Mac 5.0 ( 6 reviews ) Writing assistants AI notetakers View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Kuber Mehta Megaphone Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 A few days ago, I was scrolling Hacker News when I came across a benchmark of Apple’s new SpeechAnalyzer API. The results caught me off guard: Apple’s on-device model was more accurate and roughly three times faster than Whisper Small in the benchmark. That made me wonder why so many Mac dictation apps still need subscriptions and cloud-hosted transcription. So I built Megaphone. Hold Fn, speak naturally, and release. Megaphone types clean text directly into whatever app you are using. SpeechAnalyzer processes your audio while you talk, and Apple’s on-device Foundation Models clean up fillers, resolve self-corrections, and fix punctuation before the result lands. A few other things it can do: • Start with “Hey Megaphone” to generate or rewrite text directly at your cursor • Adapt formatting and vocabulary to the active app • Learn names, acronyms, and technical terms in a private Dictionary • Run in multiple languages • Use hold-to-talk, toggle recording, custom shortcuts, and voice macros There is no Megaphone account, API key, subscription, cloud transcription service, or server receiving your recordings. Megaphone is free, MIT-licensed, and built natively in Swift for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26

content: Cosyra: Run AI coding agents from your phone | Product Hunt Cosyra Run AI coding agents from your phone 409 followers Run AI coding agents from your phone 409 followers Visit website Terminals Cosyra is a mobile cloud terminal for AI development. Run Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI directly from your phone. Build with AI agents anywhere - no laptop or remote desktop required. Overview Launches 2 Reviews Alternatives Built with Team Awards More This is the 2nd launch from Cosyra. Terminals View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Previous Cosyra Launches Cosyra Run AI coding agents from your phone Launched on April 2nd, 2026 42 210 Reviews View all No reviews yet Be the first to leave a review for Cosyra Leave a review Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Adam Roman Cosyra Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt, Adam here, co-founder of Cosyra. I started building Cosyra because I kept running into the same annoying problem. I’d give a coding agent a task, walk away from my laptop, and come back later to discover it had been waiting for an answer the whole time. I wanted the agent in my pocket instead. Our first version put the terminal on your phone. After watching our first 50 developers use it, we realized the terminal wasn’t the most important part. The persistent workspace was. Cosyra v2.0 is a platform for your coding agents that you access from your phone. Your Ubuntu workspace keeps your repos, branches, files, installed dependencies, terminal sessions, and agent work together. Close the app, come back later, and continue where you left off. Your laptop doesn’t need to stay awake. You can still work through a full terminal, connect GitHub, switch between sessions, and preview localhost apps. We also added a chat experience for people who are less comfortable living in the terminal. You can try Cosyra free for up to 10 hours over 7 days. I
